message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is unexpected. Alison says she never received my message with the new list of times. It seems like there was a communication error. I need to resend the list of available slots for Elena and David. This is a critical step to get us back on track. I will copy the message I drafted in my first session and post it again to the workspace. This is the only way to resolve this issue and move forward with scheduling the meeting. I'll post the message and then end my session, hoping that this time it gets through to her. It's frustrating to have lost time, but the only thing to do is to try again. I need to make sure I am very clear in my communication this time.It seems my previous message with the updated times didn't get through to Alison. I need to resend it so we can find a suitable time for all four partners. I'll post the new list of available slots for Elena and David to the workspace again.

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments:

Tue Nov 17: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM, 11:30 AM
Wed Nov 18: 1:30 PM

Let me know which of these works for everyone.

Best,
Brad"}
